reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: Section 5 is a revenue-share under which money flows from Kubient to the Customer, and the Customer's only affirmative payment obligation is applicable sales/use taxes — no liquidated damages, penalty, shortfall or minimum-fee construct payable by the Customer.

The Section 4(a) sentence ('Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period') is correctly characterised as preserving Kubient's share of revenue actually generated during the 90-day notice period rather than a Customer-payable early-termination fee, so treating it as compliant rather than a deviation avoids over-flagging.

The caveat that fee mechanics reside in Exhibits (outside this document) is an appropriate completeness note and does not undercut the compliant classification; the reference to Section 7(a) is contextual only and is not relied on for the conclusion.
